newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzania's Nyerere pays tribute to Deng.
newsitem.headline: Tanzania's Nyerere pays tribute to Deng.

text.p: Former Tanzanian president Julius Nyerere, who for decades applied Chinese socialist policies to Tanzania, on Friday mourned the death of China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping.

Nyerere said in a letter to China's President Jiang Zemin: "It is with feelings of solidarity and sadness that I ask you on behalf of the people of your country as well as your colleagues to accept my condolences as together and in unity you mourn the death of China's oldest leader and guide Comrade Deng Xiaoping."
Nyerere said he met Deng Xiaoping many times and was always impressed by his "sharpness of mind" and "commitment to the unity of China."
Tanzania President Benjamin Mkapa said Deng Xiaoping would be mourned by all Tanzanians.

"The death of comrade Deng Xiaoping who led China in its modernisation programme is a big blow to the Chinese people and all progressive peoples throughout the world including Tanzanians," he said in a tribute printed in the ruling Chama Cha Mapinduzi (Party of the Revolution-CCM) newspaper on Friday.

Nyerere, who stepped down in 1985 after 25 years as Tanzania's president, used Chinese socialism as a model, nationalising banks and industry and grouping the rural population into collective villages.
